[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested layout for the Annotation Tool screen includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Top Navigation Bar: Contains the logo, page title, user menu, and other global navigation elements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Left Sidebar: Contains the document outline and label hierarchy, as well as any other tools or controls related to navigation or annotation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Main Content Area: Contains the document being annotated, with the label toolbar displayed either above or below it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Right Sidebar: Contains the label suggestion feature, label conflict resolution tool, and label history, as well as any other tools or controls related to annotation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Bottom Navigation Bar: Contains the pagination controls, progress bar, zoom controls, and any other tools or controls related to navigation or annotation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This layout allows users to easily access all the necessary tools and controls while annotating the document, and provides a clear separation between the different areas of the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is designed to be flexible and scalable, accommodating documents of different sizes and complexity.
